description: crate-jmap-mail-server/src/mdn.rs:148-149: the comment says 'per draft §2.1' for the onSuccessUpdateEmail/ validation, but the operative 'MUST reject' clause is in draft-ietf-jmap-mdn-17 §3.1 (the MDN/send method section), not §2.1 (the Mdn object definition section). Wrong section citation is a genuine auditing trap: a maintainer checking the validation logic against the spec will look in §2.1, not find it clearly, and doubt whether the implementation is correct. Fix: change '§2.1' to '§3.1' in the comment at line 149 (and the matching comment at line 152).
title: Fix wrong spec section in handle_mdn_send Step 3 comment
